subject: Civic Education
competence: Describes the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour.
unique_learning_outcome: Describes the importance of working with a sense of dignity of labour.
Presents facts to show that working with a sense of dignity of labour causes job satisfaction.
Explains the benefits gained by working with a sense of dignity of labour.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of dignity of labour and its importance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Listen to the introduction and take notes.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the benefits of dignity of labour.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and present findings.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions

summary: Recap the importance of dignity of labour and its benefits.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check on all learning outcomes.
post_activity: Complete a workbook exercise on dignity of labour.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
